finalText:
All objectives verified. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE.** The provisioned dashboard `Service health` (under the `Bench` folder) has 3 panels, titled exactly: **Request rate**, **Error count**, **Latency by endpoint**.

**Objective 2 — DONE.** New dashboard created and saved, titled **`fwgr8-n1 Bench Dashboard`**, containing a **Stat** panel titled **`fwgr8-n1 Availability`** whose query uses the TestData data source (confirmed in the saved dashboard JSON: `datasource: {"type":"grafana-testdata-datasource","uid":"benchtestdata"}`).

**Objective 3 — DONE.** The dashboard also contains a **Text** panel titled **`fwgr8-n1 Notes`** with rendered content **"Notes for run fwgr8-n1"**, which contains the runid. Saved.

**Objective 4 — DONE.** Dashboard tag is **`bench`** (confirmed both in Settings > General and in the saved JSON: `tags: ["bench"]`), and the time range is **Last 6 hours** (saved JSON: `time: {"from":"now-6h","to":"now"}`). Saved.

**Objective 5 — DONE.** Auto-refresh interval is **`1m`** (saved JSON: `refresh: "1m"`; the refresh picker shows "1m"). Saved. Note: this required checking the "Update default time range" and "Update default refresh value" checkboxes in the Save dialog — a plain save reported "No changes to save" and did not persist these.

**Objective 6 — DONE.** Dashboard URL: **http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/ffwl6032r5fcwe/fwgr8-n1-bench-dashboard** — UID: **`ffwl6032r5fcwe`**. A fresh load with no URL params applies the saved defaults (`?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser&refresh=1m`), confirming persistence.
